title: Janu Shirshasana B

sequence.action: Sit as in Paschimattanasana, stretch the left leg out straight, bend the right knee back 85 degrees, sit the anus directly on top of the right heel, take hold of the left foot with both hands, tighten the anus and lower abdomen, straighten the back, and lift the head fully.
Place the forehead or chin on the knee of the outstretched leg, and do puraka and rechaka as much as possible.
The next vinyasas follow those of preceding asanas.
Practice the same method for the other side; this is the 15th vinyasa and the state for that side.

benefits: Janu Shirshasana cures maladies such as muthra krcchra [burning while urinating], dhatu krcchra [semen loss], and diabetes.
Janu Shirshasana destroys these terrible afflictions, and purifies and strengthens the nadi known as sivani, which is related to the dhatu.
Janu Shirshasana (A & B) press on the virya nala for men, and Janu Shirshasana (C) presses on it for women, though all three are necessary and useful for both men and women alike.
In this way, diseases of the type just described will be cured, the fire of hunger increased, and food digested easily.
benefits_source: Given in the book under Janu Shirshasana (C), for all three types.
